nodes.name: Sklearn Multiclass One-Vs-Rest Postprocessing Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic one-vs-rest postprocessing helpers above the deferred estimator predict, decision_function, and predict_proba callback boundary.

nodes.name: one_vs_rest_binary_predict_threshold
nodes.description: Resolve sklearn's binary one-vs-rest predict threshold from whether the underlying estimator contributes decision scores or probabilities.
nodes.type_signature: (*, estimator_has_decision_function: bool, estimator_is_classifier: bool = True) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: one_vs_rest_multilabel_indicator_csc
nodes.description: Build the CSC indicator matrix used by sklearn's multilabel one-vs-rest predict branch from already-computed per-class response scores and a scalar threshold.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function performs linear-time element-wise array operations or copying over samples and features.

nodes.name: one_vs_rest_positive_probability_matrix
nodes.description: Transpose per-estimator positive-class probabilities into sklearn's sample-by-class one-vs-rest probability matrix.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: one_vs_rest_binary_probability_matrix
nodes.description: Expand a single positive-class probability column into the two-class probability matrix sklearn returns when one one-vs-rest estimator is present.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function performs linear-time element-wise array operations or copying over samples and features.

nodes.name: one_vs_rest_normalized_probability_matrix
nodes.description: Normalize one-vs-rest class probabilities row-wise for single-label multiclass output.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function performs linear-time element-wise array operations or copying over samples and features.

nodes.name: one_vs_rest_decision_output
nodes.description: Shape one-vs-rest decision outputs as a vector for one estimator or a sample-by-class matrix otherwise.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function performs linear-time element-wise array operations or copying over samples and features.
